scope: Release Rust ZIP core and wrappers versus Chromium fflate; persistent Node stdin JSON bridge and one-shot CLI startup measured separately.
limitations: Not Tauri IPC, native WebView, OS file IO, full Vue app, XML/OOXML semantic parsing, or Microsoft Office.
Compression backends and validation work differ. Level 1 is analogous, not identical compression.
P95 uses nearest rank over 25 samples (3 in smoke); batches report per-operation times, not individual-call tail latency.
Results are a single-machine diagnostic and include allocator/GC behavior.
